name: Note RIS Export
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: If your notes keep the title in paper_title, set the title key to paper_title in the settings. The other RIS fields work the same way.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Note RIS Export is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your research notes.
